metric_definitions.new_qualified_original: New unique government-publisher URL actually retrieved and independently subject-classified
metric_definitions.useful_investigation: Named research question, independently cited original, dated factual assertion and explicit verifiable next action
metric_definitions.actual_value: A researcher advances a real case or records request to a verifiable answer; never infer time saved
metric_definitions.deduplication: Unique canonical original URL across every source tier; document family is also reviewed, URLs are not sufficient to prove different substance

next_20_target: Acquire at least two government originals in jurisdictions currently represented by one source, with a source-supported research action for each; do not add duplicative publication feeds merely to inflate counts.
